name: Japan 15 km settlers hotseat: Oda and Date growth, 22 majors, mid-round save and resume

steps.code:
local w,h=Map.GetGridSize(); if w~=204 or h~=88 then error('map grid mismatch '..w..'x'..h) end; if #PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()~=22 then error('major count') end; local settlerType=GameInfo.Units['UNIT_SETTLER'].Index; local settlers=0; for i=0,21 do local p=Players[i]; if not p or not p:IsAlive() then error('missing major '..i) end; if p:GetCities():GetCount()~=0 then error('premade cities in slot '..i) end; local count=0; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do if u:GetUnitType()==settlerType then count=count+1 end end; if count~=1 then error('settler count in slot '..i..'='..count) end; settlers=settlers+count end; if settlers~=22 then error('total settlers '..settlers) end
local expectedRoster={
  {'LEADER_JAC_ODA_NOBUHIDE','CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_DATE_TANEMUNE','CIVILIZATION_JAC_DATE'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO','CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHINA'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_HOJO_UJITSUNA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_HOJO'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_YAMANOUCHI_UESUGI_NORIMASA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_YAMANOUCHI_UESUGI'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_TAKEDA_NOBUTORA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_NAGAO_TAMEKAGE','CIVILIZATION_JAC_NAGAO'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_IMAGAWA_UJITERU','CIVILIZATION_JAC_IMAGAWA'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_MATSUDAIRA_KIYOYASU','CIVILIZATION_JAC_MATSUDAIRA'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_ASAKURA_TAKAKAGE','CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASAKURA'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_ASHIKAGA_YOSHIHARU','CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHIKAGA'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_MIYOSHI_NAGAYOSHI','CIVILIZATION_JAC_MIYOSHI'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_ROKKAKU_SADAYORI','CIVILIZATION_JAC_ROKKAKU'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_HONGANJI_SHONYO','CIVILIZATION_JAC_HONGANJI'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_OUCHI_YOSHITAKA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_OUCHI'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_AMAGO_TSUNEHISA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_AMAGO'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_MORI_MOTONARI','CIVILIZATION_JAC_MORI'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_CHOSOKABE_KUNICHIKA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_CHOSOKABE'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_OTOMO_YOSHIAKI','CIVILIZATION_JAC_OTOMO'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_SHIMAZU_TAKAHISA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_SHIMAZU'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_RYUKYU_SHO_SEI','CIVILIZATION_JAC_RYUKYU'},
  {'LEADER_JAC_AINU_TARIKONA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_AINU'},
}
local majors=PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()
if #majors~=22 then error('major count') end
local seen={}
for _,major in ipairs(majors) do
  local pid=major:GetID()
  if type(pid)~='number' or pid~=math.floor(pid) or pid<0 or pid>21 or seen[pid] then error('unexpected major slot '..tostring(pid)) end
  seen[pid]=true
end
local humans=0
for pid=0,21 do
  local p=Players[pid]
  local config=PlayerConfigurations[pid]
  if not seen[pid] or not p or not p:IsAlive() or not config then error('missing configured major '..pid) end
  if p:IsHuman()~=(pid<2) then error('human/AI mismatch in slot '..pid) end
  if p:IsHuman() then humans=humans+1 end
  if config:GetLeaderTypeName()~=expectedRoster[pid+1][1] then error('leader mismatch in slot '..pid) end
  if config:GetCivilizationTypeName()~=expectedRoster[pid+1][2] then error('civilization mismatch in slot '..pid) end
end
if humans~=2 then error('expected exactly two human majors') end
local id=Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local p=Players[id]
if not GameConfiguration.IsHotseat() or not p or not p:IsHuman() or not p:IsTurnActive() then error('active human hotseat turn required') end
if id ~= 0 or Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() ~= GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn() + 0 then error('unexpected hotseat player or round') end
return tostring(Game.GetCurrentGameTurn())..'|'..tostring(id)

if not GameConfiguration.IsHotseat() then error('hotseat required') end
if not Game:GetProperty('JAC_POC_GROWTHUI_INITIALIZED') then error('growth not initialized') end
local current=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(); local active=Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local baseline=JAC_HOTSEAT_GROWTH_PREVIOUS
local nextGrowth={}; local rows={tostring(current),tostring(active)}
for pid=0,1 do
  local p=Players[pid]
  if not p or not p:IsHuman() then error('two human players required') end
  local units={}; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do table.insert(units,u) end
  table.sort(units,function(a,b) return a:GetID()<b:GetID() end)
  local count=0
  for _,u in ipairs(units) do
    local r=u:GetProperty('JAC_POC_GROWTHUI_WARLORD')
    if r then
      count=count+1
      if type(r.Level)~='number' or r.Level<1 or r.Level>30 or r.Level~=math.floor(r.Level) or type(r.XP)~='number' or r.XP<0 or r.XP~=math.floor(r.XP) then error('invalid growth numbers') end
      if type(r.Equipment)~='table' then error('invalid growth equipment') end
      local last=r.LastXPTurn
      if last~=nil and (type(last)~='number' or last~=math.floor(last)) then error('invalid growth turn') end
      local total=r.XP
      for level=1,r.Level-1 do total=total+math.floor(30*level^1.5+0.5) end
      local key=tostring(pid)..':'..tostring(u:GetID())
      if nextGrowth[key] then error('duplicate growth unit '..key) end
      local previous=baseline and baseline[key]
      if baseline and not previous then error('unexpected growth unit '..key) end
      if previous then
        local metadataChanged=r.Personality~=previous.personality or r.Trait~=previous.trait or r.Artifact~=previous.artifact or #r.Equipment~=#previous.equipment
        if not metadataChanged then
          for i=1,#r.Equipment do if r.Equipment[i]~=previous.equipment[i] then metadataChanged=true; break end end
        end
        if metadataChanged then
          if pid==active then error('active growth metadata changed for '..key) end
          error('inactive growth record changed for '..key)
        end
        if pid==active then
          local increment=previous.last==current and 0 or 20
          if total~=previous.total+increment then error('growth did not advance once for '..key) end
          if last~=current then error('active player growth was not credited for '..key) end
        elseif r.Level~=previous.level or r.XP~=previous.xp or last~=previous.last then
          error('inactive growth record changed for '..key)
        end
      end
      local equipment={}; for i=1,#r.Equipment do equipment[i]=r.Equipment[i] end
      nextGrowth[key]={total=total,last=last,level=r.Level,xp=r.XP,personality=r.Personality,trait=r.Trait,equipment=equipment,artifact=r.Artifact}
      table.insert(rows,table.concat({pid,u:GetID(),r.Level,r.XP,r.Personality,r.Trait,table.concat(r.Equipment,','),r.Artifact or 'none',r.LastXPTurn or -1},'~'))
    end
  end
  if count~=2 then error('expected 2 growth records for player '..pid..', got '..count) end
end
if baseline then for key,_ in pairs(baseline) do if not nextGrowth[key] then error('missing growth unit '..key) end end end
JAC_HOTSEAT_GROWTH_PREVIOUS=nextGrowth
return table.concat(rows,'|')

JAC_HOTSEAT_GROWTH_PREVIOUS=nextGrowth
return table.concat(rows,'|')
